# Payment codes: every scheme and its fields

<!-- generated by tools/gen_pay_docs.py from src/bobina/pay.py: do not edit by hand -->

One block, ```` ```pay {scheme=…} ````, with the same field names for every scheme. This page says what
each field means in each scheme, its name in the scheme's specification and its limit. The same text is
in `bobina help pay SCHEME` (`--json` for programs). The block itself: [FORMAT.md §6.3](FORMAT.md).

| Field | Means |
|---|---|
| `to=` | who receives: a Pix key, UPI ID, IBAN, phone, user name or link, depending on the scheme |
| `name=` | the receiver's name (some schemes require it; elsewhere it is only the caption) |
| `amount=` | the amount in the scheme's currency, 24.90 or 24,90; empty: the payer types it |
| `ref=` | your reference or order number |
| `note=` | text the payer sees |
| `caption=` | auto (default: "Pix · R$ 10,00"), none, or your own text, a line under the code |

## `pix` — Pix

✅ tested in the app: scanned by Brazilian banking apps on the MTP-II, 05/11/2026 (CPF, e-mail and phone keys)

````markdown
```pay {scheme=pix to="you@example.com" name="Shop" city="Rio" amount=10.00}
```
````

| Field | In this scheme | Official name | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to=` (required) | Pix key: CPF or CNPJ, e-mail, phone with +55, or random key (EVP) | 26.01 chave | 77; CPF/CNPJ check digits verified; punctuation removed |
| `name=` | receiver name the bank app shows | 59 Merchant Name | 25; accents dropped |
| `city=` | receiver city | 60 Merchant City | 15; accents dropped; default BRASIL |
| `amount=` | in R$; empty or 0: the payer types it | 54 Transaction Amount | up to 9 999 999.99 |
| `ref=` | transaction id (txid), for your reconciliation | 62.05 txid | 25 letters and digits |
| `note=` | description the payer sees | 26.02 descrição | 73 minus the key length |

## `upi` — UPI

⚠ not tested in a payment app

````markdown
```pay {scheme=upi to="shop@okbank" name="Chai Point" amount=120}
```
````

| Field | In this scheme | Official name | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to=` (required) | receiver's UPI ID (VPA) | pa | name@bank |
| `name=` (required) | receiver name (UPI asks for it) | pn |  |
| `amount=` | in ₹; empty: the payer types it | am (with cu=INR) | 2 decimals |
| `ref=` | transaction reference | tr |  |
| `note=` | text the payer sees | tn |  |

## `epc` — SEPA

⚠ not tested in a payment app

````markdown
```pay {scheme=epc to="DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00" name="Café Sol" amount=12.50 note="Invoice 42"}
```
````

| Field | In this scheme | Official name | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to=` (required) | receiver's IBAN (spaces allowed) | line 7, IBAN | check digits verified |
| `name=` (required) | receiver name, as the bank knows it | line 6, beneficiary | 70 |
| `amount=` | in €; empty: the payer types it | line 8, amount | 0.01 to 999 999 999.99 |
| `ref=` | an RF creditor reference goes structured; any other text joins note | line 10, remittance (structured) | RF + 2 check digits + 21 (verified) |
| `note=` | remittance text | line 11, remittance (unstructured) | 140, with ref; not with an RF ref |
| `bic=` | receiver's bank code; optional inside the EEA | line 5, BIC | 8 or 11 |

## `promptpay` — PromptPay

⚠ not tested in a payment app

````markdown
```pay {scheme=promptpay to="081 234 5678" amount=120}
```
````

| Field | In this scheme | Official name | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to=` (required) | phone (10 digits), national or tax ID (13) or e-wallet ID (15) | 29.01 / 29.02 / 29.03 | the number of digits picks the kind |
| `name=` | shown in the caption only; not part of the code |  |  |
| `amount=` | in ฿; empty: the payer types it | 54 Transaction Amount | 2 decimals |

⚠ not tested in a payment app

```
````

| Field | In this scheme | Official name | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to=` (required) | UEN, or Singapore mobile (+65 8… or 9…) | 26.02 proxy (26.01 type) | UEN 8 to 13 |
| `name=` (required) | receiver name as registered for PayNow | 59 Merchant Name | 25; accents dropped |

## `bitcoin` — Bitcoin

✅ tested in the app: scanned with a bitcoin wallet on the MTP-II, 09/11/2026: address and amount read

````markdown
```pay {scheme=bitcoin to="bc1qar0srrr7xfkvy5l643lydnw9re59gtzzwf5mdq" amount=0.001}
```
````

| Field | In this scheme | Official name | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to=` (required) | bitcoin address | address | bc1…, 1… or 3… |
| `name=` | label the wallet shows | label |  |
| `amount=` | in BTC | amount | 8 decimals |
| `note=` | message the wallet shows | message |  |

## `lightning` — Lightning

⚠ not tested in a payment app

````markdown
```pay {scheme=lightning to="you@wallet.example"}
```
````

| Field | In this scheme | Official name | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to=` (required) | BOLT11 invoice (lnbc…), LNURL or lightning address | lightning: |  |
| `name=` | shown in the caption only; not part of the code |  |  |

- amount: an invoice carries its own; an address lets the payer type it

## `paypal` — PayPal

✅ tested in the app: scanned with the app on the MTP-II, 09/11/2026: it opened the pay or profile screen

````markdown
```pay {scheme=paypal to="yourname" amount=10 currency=USD}
```
````

| Field | In this scheme | Official name | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to=` (required) | your PayPal.me name (or the paypal.me link) | paypal.me/NAME | letters, digits, . _ - (up to 64) |
| `name=` | shown in the caption only; not part of the code |  |  |
| `amount=` | empty: the payer types it | paypal.me/NAME/AMOUNT | 2 decimals |
| `currency=` | 3-letter code; default your account's | suffix of the amount (10USD) | 3 letters |

## `other` — closed apps

⚠ not tested in a payment app

````markdown
```pay {scheme=other label="WeChat Pay"}
wxp://f2f0…
```
````

| Field | In this scheme | Official name | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label=` | the app's name, for the caption |  |  |
| `name=` | shown in the caption only; not part of the code |  |  |
| `amount=` | shown in the caption only; the pasted payload decides |  |  |

- the block body is the text read from the app's own QR code, reprinted as it is
